# Forge inspiration

`lib/vae_memory.py` adapts the halo-strip VAE upsampling idea from Haoming02/sd-webui-forge-classic PR #1512 to existing Diffusers modules. It is provided under AGPL-3.0-or-later; Forge's license and copyright notices are retained in `LICENSE`. No Forge-core or dependency source is copied into the worker or modified. Existing model and other component licenses remain unchanged.

Source: https://github.com/Haoming02/sd-webui-forge-classic/pull/1512
